title: 表单从 view 拆成独立的 form 元数据类型，对外表单并入（第一步：ADR 与分卡）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzufqmKuir7GiTdwGd3Z

③ maintainer direct order (with ruling) · Source: maintainer (Yibo Wang), 2026-11-24, os-support-ai bug-discussion thread.
- 05:19Z: 「view（视图）类型里面总共有哪些」 → answered: list types grid/kanban/gallery/calendar/timeline/gantt/map/chart/tree/timesheet, form types simple/tabbed/wizard, two shapes (container `form`/`formViews`, item `viewKind: 'form'`).
- 05:21Z: 「是否建议表单从 view 中更直接拆分出来，比如叫form元数据？」
- 05:22Z: 「用fable分析」 (independent analysis, summarised below; full report linked at the end).
- 05:22Z: 「如果分拆的话，对外表单的功能就不用单独开发了，就合并到这个元数据类型中。」
- 05:23Z: 「现在对外表单开发的任务先暂停」 (recorded on #36444, comment 7122924165).
- 05:33Z, decision card 「表单要不要从 view 拆成独立的 form 元数据类型？」 → **「拆成 form 类型，对外表单并入」** (options not taken: keep forms in `view` and retire only the container shape; keep everything as is).

**This supersedes** the 01:08Z option 「Studio 单独一页，存储不变」 recorded on #36444 as ruling 7118881549 (items 1 and 2: a Studio Developer → Public Forms page, storage unchanged as `formViews.<name>` in the object's view), and the "Definition (unchanged shape)" part of #36444 ruling 7100386248. The ruling is also recorded on #36444 and #36505.

Grading: `area:build · Feature · a new metadata type (form) carved out of view; public forms move into it · builders and administrators who author or publish forms · evidence: read from code (fable analysis + spot checks)`. A new metadata type is a Feature (filing gate: new metadata type ⇒ separate Feature card). **p1** by the blocker rule: #36444 (p1, open, paused) cannot finish until this lands, and it carries `Blocked-by:` this card. Area is `build` (Studio builds forms; metadata authoring), not `ux`.

Dedupe: `gh api search/issues` (is:issue, closed included) on `form metadata type` (3628 hits, top: #36860 #35879 #31527 #36505 #36444), `defineForm` (23), `viewKind form retire` (20), `split form view type` (790), `public form type` (2281). No card on the same mechanism. Touching: #36444 (paused, becomes part of this work), #36505 (items 1–3 + 5 continue independently; item 4 paused), #36797 / #36798 (Studio rail and docs on named default/create forms: re-read once the ADR lands), #36860 (metadata list columns: a `form` type will need its columns row).

Reader: seat objectstack#3 routes. Step 1 is a design (ADR) card for one dev at contract tier; it names the implementation cards. Paths on main 14f4d8f8.

## Today (read from code)

- `view` carries both lists and forms (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`): `FormViewSchema` (~5329, `type` simple/tabbed/wizard), the container `ViewSchema` (~5889: `list`, `form`, `listViews`, `formViews`) and the ADR-0017 item `{ name, object, viewKind: 'list'|'form', config }` with per-kind overlay arms (~6368–6900). `form` is not in `MetadataTypeSchema` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`). ADR-0084 already lists `form` beside `view` in the Interface pillar.
- **Record create and edit read no form view** since #36425: create dialog, full-page create, action-opened create and edit lay out by the object's `fieldGroups` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:141-150`; `addRecord.formView` retired, `view.zod.ts:2186-2194`). No per-role or per-position form assignment exists.
- Named forms have three consumers only: public forms at `/f/:slug`; action `type: 'form'` → `/forms/:name` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:693,719`; `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`); Setup / Studio previews.
- Anonymous doors: `resolveFormBySlug` lists `type: 'view'` plus per-package layers and runs `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`, which scans three shapes (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:236-260`; `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts:103-121`). Withdrawal (`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`) is a narrowing-only kill switch matched by slot or slug on `view` bodies.
- Write path: intake advisory (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`, `protocol.ts:2169`), container collision judgement (`protocol-save.ts:175-195`). Loader expands containers into items (`packages/metadata/src/view-container-expansion.ts`, objectql `engine-registration.ts`). Overlay: `view: listed` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts:319`).
- Shipped public-forms UI: Setup → Configuration → Public forms (#36697, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/publicForms.ts`, saves a `view` override in the app's `.custom` package); Studio `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/PublicFormsPage.tsx`; open draft PR #36784 (designer, `publicFormDesign.ts`), paused.
- Translations: `objects.<object>._views.<form>.title` and `.submitBehavior.*` (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`). Lint: ~15 form-view rule files (e.g. `validate-internal-form-views.ts`, `validate-public-form-file-fields.ts`).
- No runtime list/form coupling remains (view switcher takes list items only, `MetadataProvider.tsx:654-655`; app nav `viewName` targets lists, `app.zod.ts:502`). Residuals: `anonymousFormObjectName` falls back to the container's `list.data.object`; list and form items share the `<object>.<key>` name space; `.custom` override rows and withdrawal matching are keyed on `view` bodies.
- Size: 81 non-test + 166 test files in `packages/` and `ui/` use `formViews` / `viewKind: 'form'`; hotcrm 2 source files (`lead.view.ts`, `case.view.ts`) + 7 tests.

## Decided (the ruling)

1. A new metadata type **`form`**, addressed by name, bound to one object (carries `object` itself), body = today's `FormViewSchema`. Its content is named forms that have a consumer: **public forms** (the main content, `sharing` included) and forms an action of `type: 'form'` opens.
2. **Public forms are not a separate feature**: they are `form` items. Their list, detail and edit come from the `form` type (generic metadata surface plus a dedicated editor), not from a separate Studio page.
3. `view` becomes **lists only**. The record create/edit form stays on the object's `fieldGroups` (already true since #36425) and does not become a `form` item.

## This card: the design (ADR) step

Write and land the ADR work, then file the implementation cards it names. Settle at least:
- **ADRs**: amend ADR-0017 (`viewKind` list-only; form arm tombstoned on the schedule below); a new ADR for the `form` kind that passes ADR-0088's real-consumer test (no `form` content without a consumer: "custom create forms" and "wizards" qualify only when an action opens them); amend ADR-0146 D2 with a `form` override row (the pin test in `customization-package.test.ts` forces it). ADR-0084 needs no change.
- **Migration path**: loader dual-reads the three old shapes (`form`, `formViews.*`, `viewKind: 'form'` items) into `form` items (precedent: container expansion); an ADR-0087 conversion + `os migrate meta` for sources; a stored-row migration for `sys_metadata` rows and `.custom` overrides of type `view` on form items. Old shapes tombstoned only in a major release (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`); adding the type is `added`.
- **Security-sensitive door**: during dual-read the anonymous doors and the withdrawal judgement must read BOTH types, so a form switched off as a `view` override cannot re-open as a `form` (ablation tests required on the implementation card).
- **Name space** for `form` items (today's `<object>.<key>` shared with lists; PR #36784 refuses clashes) and the `object` binding rule.
- **Translations**: a new key family (e.g. `forms.<name>.*`) with the old `_views.<form>` keys read as fallback.
- **Disposition of shipped / paused work**: #36697 Setup page kept and re-pointed from `'view'` to `'form'` (about 10 call sites in `publicForms.ts`, drop the `viewKind` filter); #36784's `publicFormDesign.ts` and tests kept and re-hosted as the `form` type's editor; `PublicFormsPage.tsx` and the Form-tab switch in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` retired. What the generic metadata surface covers vs what stays dedicated (designer rules, admin on/off as a switch-only override, copy address, tenancy intake advisory, 404 for a switched-off form).
- **Card split and order** (suggested by the analysis): ① this ADR; ② spec + server: type, registry and override rows, dual-read, doors and withdrawal over both types; ③ UI: re-point #36697, land the designer as the `form` editor, retire `PublicFormsPage` (closes #36444); ④ hotcrm source move + translation keys; ⑤ tombstone old shapes + stored-row migration (major). #36505 items 1–3 + 5 proceed independently.

Hold until this card lands: #36444 / PR #36784 stay paused (no push, ready or queue); #36505 item 4 stays paused.

## Acceptance

- ADR PR(s) merged covering every bullet above, with `Metadata-protocol:` stated for each implementation step.
- Implementation cards ②–⑤ filed with `Blocked-by:` lines in order; #36444 gets `Blocked-by:` card ③; #36505 item 4 closed as superseded or re-pointed.
- A ruling comment on #36444 and #36505 points to the ADR.

Analysis: fable read-only report, `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-bug-discussion/form-split-fable.md` in the fleet project (summarised above; file:line references at main 14f4d8f8).
